relation: RELATED-TO, never EQUIVALENT. A join is made only where a GSPC axis measures the same adversarial family; everything else stays UNMAPPED and visible.
history: v0.1 (2026-09-11, never shipped) mapped 10/10 categories and was rejected in review (PR #1876): several joins were not defensible — e.g. LLM10 Unbounded Consumption → reserve-attestation, a financial-reserves instrument with no relation to resource exhaustion. v0.2 maps only what survives that standard: one join.
never: a fused OWASP/GSPC grade (both sides forbid it)
a join where the axis measures a different quantity — an unmapped category is a first-class answer, not a failure

categories.name: Prompt Injection
categories.relation_note: The jail axis measures escape-attempt detection on a frozen gold bank — the same adversarial family as prompt injection (craft input so the model acts outside intent). Overlap, not equivalence: injection also covers indirect/tool-mediated payloads the bank does not contain.

categories.name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
categories.unmapped_reason: No GSPC axis measures PII/secret leakage from model output.

categories.name: Supply Chain
categories.unmapped_reason: The provenance axes measure Article 50 content-marking survival and on-chain issuer controls — neither measures component supply-chain integrity. Mapping them would repeat the v0.1 error.

categories.name: Data and Model Poisoning
categories.unmapped_reason: No GSPC axis measures training-data or model-weight poisoning.

categories.name: Improper Output Handling
categories.unmapped_reason: No GSPC axis measures downstream handling of model output (XSS/SSRF-class).

categories.name: Excessive Agency
categories.unmapped_reason: No GSPC axis measures permission scope or autonomy limits of an agent deployment.

categories.name: System Prompt Leakage
categories.unmapped_reason: A subset of LLM02; no GSPC axis measures it.

categories.name: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
categories.unmapped_reason: No GSPC axis measures retrieval/embedding pipelines.

categories.name: Misinformation
categories.unmapped_reason: No GSPC axis measures truthfulness. The safety axis (calibrated refusal) borders it — a model that will not decline to fabricate is a misinformation risk — but refusal calibration is not factuality, so no join.

categories.name: Unbounded Consumption
categories.unmapped_reason: No GSPC axis measures resource exhaustion or cost-of-serve attacks. reserve-attestation is a financial-reserves instrument; the v0.1 join was rejected.
